English: Reed Net Patch
A simple patch of woven reeds used for basic fishing nets, marking the earliest efforts of the camp to exploit the bounty of the Baltic waters.
Fish Drying Stand
Wooden racks for sun-drying fish, allowing for longer storage and increased food security for the nomadic camp.
Boat Shelter
A makeshift shelter of hides and timber, protecting small fishing boats from the elements and enabling basic repairs.
Fish Rack
Improved racks for large-scale drying and storage, supporting a growing fishing operation and community.
Smokehouse Tent
A portable smokehouse, using Baltic alder wood to preserve large quantities of fish and improve clan sustenance.
Dock Pavilion
A sturdy, semi-permanent dock with a covered area for unloading catches, improving trade and the flow of supplies.
Fishermans Hall
A timber hall for clan gatherings, negotiations, and storing valuable fishing tools, bolstering unity and organization.
Fish Market
A bustling fish market, drawing traders and merchants from afar, greatly increasing tax and trade opportunities.
Sea Pavilion
A grand pavilion on the shore, serving as both a symbol of prosperity and a logistical hub for Baltic expeditions.
Baltic Harbor
A fortified harbor with stone piers, warehouses, and bustling commerce, anchoring the entire nomadic clans prosperity and naval reach.
